name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
eligibility_facts: landholding farmer families, SHGs, user groups, cooperatives, FPOs, entrepreneurs
women farmers given priority in source
hard_exclusions: source says benefit to those who have not taken subsidy from another central scheme earlier
questions: What agricultural machine or equipment do you need?
Are you buying it for your own farm or setting up a custom-hiring service?

eligibilityCriteria.source_text: landholding farmer families, SHGs, user groups, cooperatives, FPOs, entrepreneurs

question.en: Are you part of a landholding farmer family, SHG, user group, cooperative, FPO, or an eligible enterprise?
question.or: ଆପଣ ଜମିଧାରୀ ଚାଷୀ ପରିବାର, SHG, ବ୍ୟବହାରକାରୀ ଗୋଷ୍ଠୀ, ସମବାୟ, FPO କିମ୍ବା ଯୋଗ୍ୟ ଉଦ୍ୟମର ଅଂଶ କି?

eligibilityCriteria.source_text: women farmers given priority in source

description.en: Women farmers receive priority; this is not a women-only eligibility restriction.
description.or: ମହିଳା ଚାଷୀଙ୍କୁ ପ୍ରାଥମିକତା ମିଳେ; ଏହା କେବଳ ମହିଳାଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଯୋଗ୍ୟତା ସୀମା ନୁହେଁ।

eligibilityCriteria.source_text: [EXCLUSION] source says benefit to those who have not taken subsidy from another central scheme earlier

question.en: Have you previously received a subsidy from another central scheme for this benefit?
question.or: ଏହି ଲାଭ ପାଇଁ ଆପଣ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଅନ୍ୟ କେନ୍ଦ୍ରୀୟ ଯୋଜନାରୁ ସବସିଡି ପାଇଛନ୍ତି କି?
